senses.en_definition: A matter or task requiring attention or action.
Affairs relating to a particular field, responsibility, or person.
The management, administration, or running of something.

messages.en: Let's have lunch together today. Want to join us?
Can't make it today. I've got some stuff to sort out at the bank. Shall we have lunch together tomorrow instead?

senses.en_definition: To handle, arrange, or take care of something so that it proceeds smoothly.

messages.en: We haven't booked the hotel for next week's course yet, have we? I'm worried there won't be any rooms left.
No worries, I'll sort out the booking tomorrow morning. Can you send me the list of names tonight?
Sure, I'll send it after dinner. Thanks, that's a bit of a relief!
Your hard work is starting to pay off. Don't give up.
Thanks. I want to keep at it until I succeed.

senses.en_definition: Of the highest quality; best or outstanding.

messages.en: Do you want to change jobs because the pay there is low?
The pay isn't the main reason. I'm just tired of commuting so far every day.
